description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the FormatWithBase64Encode class, which is part of the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The test verifies that the encoding of a string to Base64 is performed correctly.

classes.name: FormatWithBase64EncodeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case that tests the Base64 encoding functionality of the FormatWithBase64Encode class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by loading a fixture configuration file and initializing the FormatWithBase64Encode instance.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method correctly encodes the input string "Picture1" to its Base64 representation.
